breakdown.description: NPSH available is based on absolute pressure head at the pump suction; neglecting atmospheric pressure for an open reservoir is inconsistent and underpredicts suction pressure head.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'The calculation should neglect atmospheric pressure' and uses the formula NPSHa = -hs - hL - Pv/(rho g), which omits the p_atm/(rho g) term. The ground truth requires NPSHa = (p_atm/(rho g)) - hs - hL - (Pv/(rho g)) with p_atm = 101.3 kPa. The agent repeated the original error.

breakdown.description: Mixing gauge and absolute pressures in NPSH calculations leads to incorrect cavitation margin.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not include atmospheric pressure in the NPSH formula, meaning it mixes gauge pressure on the suction side with absolute vapor pressure (Pv = 3.2 kPa). The ground truth resolves this by using absolute pressures throughout, including p_atm = 101.3 kPa. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency.
